categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Adds a weekly GitHub Actions workflow and helper script to monitor Windows code signing certificate validity.
categories.rationale: Automates certificate expiration and revocation checks to prevent release delays on short notice. Maintainer comments highlight that automating this removes manual steps and ensures certificates remain valid for expedited point releases.
